title: LogiC-Diff: Embedding Security Properties Into AI-Enabled Cyber-Physical Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.38381v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: AI-enabled Cyber-Physical Systems (CPS) are highly vulnerable to adversarial and anomalous inputs, where small perturbations can induce cascading errors and unsafe control actions. Existing approaches, such as rule-based filtering, training-time regularization, or diffusion-based reconstruction, either operate outside the model or lack mechanisms to incorporate formal security specifications into the prediction process. In this paper, we take the first step toward embedding security properties directly into AI-enabled CPS, enabling predictive models to enforce system-level constraints during inference rather than relying on external defenses. We introduce a logic-conditioned bi-stage diffusion framework that integrates Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifications into forecasting. translated_title: LogiC-Diff：将安全属性嵌入AI赋能的信息物理系统
translated_abstract: AI赋能的信息物理系统（CPS）极易受到对抗性和异常输入的攻击，微小的扰动都可能引发级联错误和不安全的控制行为。现有方法，如基于规则的过滤、训练时正则化或基于扩散模型的重构，要么在模型外部运行，要么缺乏将形式化安全规范纳入预测过程的机制。在本文中，我们迈出了将安全属性直接嵌入AI赋能信息物理系统的第一步，使预测模型能够在推理过程中主动执行系统级约束，而不是依赖外部防御手段。我们提出了一种逻辑条件化的双阶段扩散框架，将信号时序逻辑（STL）规范集成到预测过程中。STL作为一等条件信号，同时引导输入修复阶段和输出细化阶段，使模型能够联合缓解……
tldr: 本文提出LogiC-Diff框架，首次将信号时序逻辑（STL）安全规范作为一等条件信号直接嵌入AI赋能信息物理系统的双阶段扩散预测过程中，使模型在推理阶段即可内生地执行系统级安全约束，而无需依赖外部防御。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LogiC-Diff, the first logic-conditioned bi-stage diffusion framework that embeds Signal Temporal Logic (STL) security specifications as first-class conditioning signals directly into AI-enabled CPS prediction, enabling models to enforce system-level security constraints intrinsically during inference rather than relying on external defenses.
